title: wire/rectangular
description: The description of a solid rectangular magnet wire Discriminator: this file matches ONLY documents with type='rectangular' (enforced by the if/required/else:false conditional, which stays invisible to code generators so the shared wireType enum keeps generating as WireType).

conductingWidth.description: The conducting width of the wire, in m

conductingHeight.description: The conducting height of the wire, in m

edgeRadius.description: The radius of the edge, in case of rectangular wire, in m

outerWidth.description: The outer width of the wire, in m

outerHeight.description: The outer height of the wire, in m
